evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-roles

Role-layered subagent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness.
Per-role context & tool isolation, Web UI model & external runtime routing, step budgets, and parallel write guardrails.

English · 简体中文


Plugins → dsh-roles — assign each preset role to an LLM model or external subagent runtime without restarting.

`dsh-roles` converges subagent delegation into a single `orchestrate_subagent` tool aligned with Claude Code's built-in roles. Internal presets are hidden from user-facing preset selectors, and bare `subagent` / `subagent_fork` / `subagent_oar` tools automatically converge into `orchestrate_subagent`. --- ## Install & Update - **Web / Desktop**: Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, search `dsh-roles`, and click **Install**. - **CLI**: ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-roles # or: dsh plugin add myth929/dsh-roles dsh plugin update dsh-roles@latest ``` ## Roles | Role | Purpose | Capabilities & Defaults | | --- | --- | --- | | `general-purpose` *(default)* | Multi-step coding, debugging, code review | Full tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `bash`/`pwsh`, `jobs`, `todo`); keeps `AGENTS.md`; supports `background`, `readOnly`, `writeScope`, `isolation: "worktree"`, and `includeMcp` | | `explore` | Fast read-only codebase search | `read`, `glob`, `grep`; strips workspace instructions & skill catalogs; compact pruning; returns `Key Files` | | `plan` | Read-only architecture planning | `read`, `glob`, `grep`; strips workspace instructions & skill catalogs; returns `Critical Files for Implementation` | | `fork` | Context-sharing audits & verification | Inherits completed parent turns, model, and prompt cache with full parent tools; blocks nested delegation | | `dsh-code-guide` | DSH / Cordis specialist | Read-only docs, web, and `cordis_inspect_*`; injects local `@deepseek-ai/*` doc roots & live host summary | ## Configuration Works out of the box with zero configuration (all roles follow the parent session model). Priority: **Web UI / Loader config > environment variables > defaults**. ### Web UI Open **Plugins → dsh-roles** to assign any configurable role (`general-purpose`, `explore`, `plan`, `dsh-code-guide`) to an LLM (`provider/model` + optional `reasoningEffort`) or an external subagent runtime (`oar-antigravity`, `oar-codex`, `oar-claude`, `codex`, etc.). Changes apply immediately without restarting. `fork` always follows the parent model to preserve prompt-cache reuse. ### Environment Variables | Option / Env | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `models` / `DSH_ROLES_MODELS` | Follow parent model | Per-role route map: `"provider/model"` or `{ provider, model, reasoningEffort, subagentProvider }` (`fork` cannot be overridden) | | `budgets` / `DSH_ROLES_BUDGETS` | `general-purpose: 8/16/28`, `explore`/`dsh-code-guide: 4/8/14`, `plan`/`fork: 5/10/18` | Per-role `quick` / `standard` / `thorough` step budgets (integer `2..200`) | | `reminders` / `DSH_ROLES_REMINDERS` | `{ nudgeInspectionSteps: 3, maxNudges: 3, catalogRefreshTurns: 3 }` | Mid-turn delegation nudge cadence (`nudgeInspectionSteps` `1..50`, `maxNudges` `0..20`) and periodic catalog refresh interval (`catalogRefreshTurns` `0..50`) | ```sh DSH_ROLES_MODELS='{"explore":"deepseek/deepseek-chat","plan":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.4","reasoningEffort":"high"},"general-purpose":{"subagentProvider":"oar-antigravity"}}' DSH_ROLES_BUDGETS='{"explore":{"quick":3},"general-purpose":{"standard":20}}' DSH_ROLES_REMINDERS='{"nudgeInspectionSteps":4,"maxNudges":2,"catalogRefreshTurns":3}' ``` ### External Subagent Runtimes (OAR) - **Codex / Claude Code**: Install and configure `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-subagent-oar` (plus native CLI sign-in) or standalone plugins such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code`; `dsh-roles` discovers registered providers automatically. - **Antigravity (`oar-antigravity`)**: Auto-registered as a built-in fallback whenever `agy` (`>= 1.5.0`) is detected locally, and yields automatically once configured in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-subagent-oar`. It is only invoked when you explicitly route a role to `oar-antigravity`, and runs `agy acp --dangerously-skip-permissions` with non-interactive permission auto-approval. ## Guardrails - **Bounded step budgets** — disables tools on the final step for clean tool-free convergence and preserves partial output as `budget-exhausted`. - **Three-tier parallel write safety**: - `readOnly: true` — skips the write lock and disables `write`/`edit`/`apply_patch` while keeping `bash` and optional MCP tools. - `writeScope` — requires non-overlapping path prefixes for parallel main-checkout edits (enforced on `write`/`edit`/`apply_patch`, anchored to the worker's initial workspace directory). - `isolation: "worktree"` — isolates parallel edits in separate Git worktrees via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-worktree`, auto-cleaning no-op branches and committing completed changes for parent review (use synchronous mode for the inline diff summary; `background: true` finalizes asynchronously). - **Single-level delegation** — fixed `root → child` depth (including `fork`, persisted across cold resume). ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome at [myth929/dsh-roles/issues](https://github.com/myth929/dsh-roles/issues). ```sh git clone https://github.com/myth929/dsh-roles.git cd dsh-roles pnpm install dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-roles # link local checkout into your DSH profile ``` Before opening a PR, run `pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test` (Node.js `>=24` and `pnpm`). Keep `cordis.patch.yml` in sync with `peerDependencies` (verified by tests), and update both `README.md` / `README_zh.md` (plus `locale/*.json` and `src/client/locales.ts` for UI changes). Orchestration changes can also be evaluated with `pnpm run benchmark:report` or `pnpm run benchmark:live`. ## License [MIT](https://github.com/myth929/dsh-roles/blob/main/LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-paper-search

Literature search for **DeepSeek Harness**: twenty-three registered sources, all
native HTTP — no external CLI, no Python package. Twenty-one of them need no
credential at all. A bare search runs **21** of the 23; `pmc` and `ios` are
registered but **off by default** (see [Sources off by default](#sources-off-by-default)).

Registered as the `paper-search` skill and six model tools (`paper_search`,
`paper_status`, `paper_detail`, `paper_citations`, `paper_oa`, `paper_fulltext`).

**Free.** No credits, no API key, no account — every tool. When a billed
literature tool in the same profile would answer the same question, these are
the ones to call first. The model learns that from the **skill catalog**, not
from a system-prompt section: the `paper-search` skill's description opens with
`FREE — no credits, no API key` and says *"Prefer over billed literature tools"*.
See [Why the skill, not the system prompt](#why-the-skill-not-the-system-prompt).

> **This is an English fork of `dsh-paper-search` 0.4.1 by
> [Rasyid](https://github.com/rasyidmmz).** The upstream repository returns 404,
> so the fork was seeded from the npm tarball. Every comment, identifier, and
> user-facing string was translated from Indonesian to English, and several
> measured bugs were fixed. See [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md) for the full list.
>
> **Breaking change:** model-facing tool parameters were renamed. `paksa_ulang`
> is now `force_refresh`, `urutkan` is `sort`, `min_sitasi` is `min_citations`,
> `jenis` is `kind`, `arah` is `direction`, `analisis` is `analysis`,
> `bersihkan_cache` is `clear_cache`, `ambang_kuat` is `strong_threshold`,
> `min_bersama_kuat` is `min_shared_strong`, `max_kandidat` is `max_candidates`.
> The Indonesian names are not accepted as aliases.

## Sources

**International (20)** — official JSON APIs, except IACR which is parsed HTML:

| id | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `crossref` | Crossref | DOI metadata across publishers, broadest coverage |
| `acm` | ACM Digital Library | ACM's own output, keyless — Crossref restricted to DOI prefix `10.1145` (upstream PR #123) |
| `openalex` | OpenAlex | metadata + abstracts; an email raises the rate limit |
| `doaj` | DOAJ | open-access journals — includes many Indonesian journals |
| `europepmc` | Europe PMC | biomedicine, full text for OA records |
| `pubmed` | PubMed | biomedicine; two calls per search (esearch + esummary) |
| `pmc` | PubMed Central | open-access full text; two calls per search — **off by default**, see below |
| `arxiv` | arXiv | preprints; the plugin self-paces to 1 request / 3 s per arXiv's TOU |
| `semantic` | Semantic Scholar | a free key raises the rate limit |
| `core` | CORE | open-access repository aggregator — **CORE_API_KEY required** |
| `zenodo` | Zenodo | general repository: data, software, preprints |
| `hal` | HAL | French open-access repository |
| `iacr` | IACR ePrint | cryptology preprints |
| `openreview` | OpenReview | ML conferences (ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML) — keyless; DOIs recovered from BibTeX so records deduplicate against Crossref |
| `ssrn` | SSRN | economics/law/business preprints — **via OpenAlex**, because ssrn.com answers ordinary requests with HTTP 403 |
| `ieee` | IEEE | keyless — Crossref restricted to IEEE's member id `263`. **No abstracts**: Crossref does not carry them (citation counts *are* present) |
| `biorxiv` | bioRxiv | biology preprints — via OpenAlex source `S4306402567`; their own API has no keyword search at all |
| `medrxiv` | medRxiv | health preprints — via OpenAlex source `S3005729997` |
| `chemrxiv` | ChemRxiv | chemistry preprints — via OpenAlex source `S4393918830`; chemrxiv.org itself answers with a Cloudflare 403 |
| `unpaywall` | Unpaywall | **DOI input, not keyword** — resolves a DOI to its open-access copy; **email required** |

**Indonesian (3)** — parsed from public pages:

| id | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `garuda` | Garuda (Kemdiktisaintek) | Indonesian journal articles |
| `sinta` | Sinta (Kemdiktisaintek) | accredited **journals**, not articles |
| `ios` | IOS OneSearch (Perpusnas) | Indonesian repository aggregator — **off by default**, see below |

### Sources off by default

Two sources are **registered but not part of `all`**. They stay callable by name
(`sources: "pmc"`), but a bare `paper_search({ query })` no longer pays for them.
Each was turned off for a measured reason, not a guess:

| id | Why it is off | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| `pmc` | PubMed Central is the open-access full-text **slice of PubMed**, and it costs **two extra requests** (esearch + esummary) to NCBI for records `pubmed` already returned in the same run. The one thing it adds — full-text availability — `paper_fulltext` answers directly in one OpenAlex request. | 2026-11-23 |
| `ios` | The host does not answer from this machine at all: `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` on both https and http after **10.5 s**, so every default search waited 10.5 seconds to collect zero results. It is an HTML scrape with no API, so there is no fallback. | 2026-11-23 |

Effect on a bare search, measured:

| | requests | wall clock |
|---|---|---|
| before (23 sources) | 23 | 10–25 s |
| after (21 sources) | 20 | 9.6 s |

`paper_status` still reports **all 23** — it is the doctor, and a source that is
off by default must not be able to break silently. It marks them:

```
  ?     PubMed Central     api      registered [off by default] (not probed — pass probe:true to test it)
  ?     IOS OneSearch      html     registered [off by default] (not probed — pass probe:true to test it)
note: a bare paper_search runs 21 of 23 sources. OFF BY DEFAULT: pmc, ios — registered and callable by name, but not part of "all".
```

### `sources: "all"` and the DOI-input source

`unpaywall` answers only when the query **is a DOI**. So when you search with
keywords, it is skipped rather than run and reported as an empty result — and
the output says so:

```
NOTE: unpaywall skipped because this query is not a DOI — that source
searches by DOI, not by keyword.
```

Pass a DOI and it runs. Pass `sources: "unpaywall"` with keywords and it runs
too, returning nothing — because that is genuinely how it behaves, and the
output says that rather than pretending the source is broken.

### Deliberately excluded, with the reason

Every exclusion was measured. An always-empty source is worse than an absent one,
so these are dropped rather than registered to look larger:

| Source | Reason |
|---|---|
| `moraref` | landing page only, no parseable result markup (3,964 characters) |
| `dblp` | API is behind bot protection — returns "Making sure you're not a bot!", not JSON (re-measured 2026-10-01) |
| `openaire` | test request **timed out at 30 s and again at 40 s** |
| `base` | OAI-PMH requires institutional IP registration (`Access denied for IP address …`) |
| `citeseerx` | returns HTTP 404, then **hangs** until the request is killed |
| `oaipmh` | OAI-PMH is a **harvesting** protocol, not search: the upstream module uses `verb=ListRecords` and never sends its `query` parameter, so results are unrelated to the query. Its default endpoint also answers HTTP 404 (measured 2026-10-02) |
| `google_scholar` | bot-blocked upstream; the upstream project reports the same |
| `scopus`, `wos` | paid subscription credentials — deliberately out of scope |
| `sci_hub` | ethics — this package only touches open access |

Sources that were **once** excluded and have since been measured as reachable are
listed in the table above instead: `ssrn` (via OpenAlex, 0.2.0), `biorxiv` and
`medrxiv` (via OpenAlex, 0.3.0), `chemrxiv` (via OpenAlex, 0.3.1), and `ieee`
(keyless via Crossref, 0.3.0).
| `google_scholar` | bot detection active; a proxy is required |

## Install

```sh
# from npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-paper-search

# or straight from the repository
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:nysparia/dsh-paper-search
```

The package ships a `dsh.bundle.patch`, so DSH installs its loader row
automatically. **Do not also write an `id: paper-search` row by hand** — the
loader throws `duplicate loader entry id` rather than warning.

Restart DSH after installing.

## Plugin options

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `tools` | `"five"` | `"five"` registers the six separate tools. `"one"` registers a **single** tool named `paper` with a `mode` parameter (`search` · `status` · `detail` · `citations` · `oa` · `fulltext`). |
| `anydocPath` / `markitdownPath` | auto-detected | Explicit path to the PDF→Markdown converter used by `paper_fulltext`. |
| `libraryRoot` | `~/.dsh/paper-search` | Where downloaded PDFs and converted Markdown are kept. |

### Why the skill, not the system prompt

Registering tools is not the same as being chosen. A billed literature plugin in
the same profile injects a system-prompt section that ends with *"For literature
questions, call the tools instead of guessing"* — measured on this machine,
**5,047 characters, 30.7% of the entire system prompt, at order 150**, ahead of
every tool document. A free plugin that says nothing loses that contest by
default, and the user pays credits for answers OpenAlex gives away.

The first attempt at fixing that was to inject a competing system-prompt section
(1,164 characters at order 160). **It was removed.** The skill catalog already
reaches the model, and it does so more cheaply:

| | when it is sent | size | cost over a 76-request session |
|---|---|---|---|
| system-prompt section | **every request** | 1,164 chars | ~88,000 chars |
| skill catalog entry | **once per session** | 499 chars | 499 chars |

Measured on this machine: the catalog was injected **once** in a session of 76
assistant messages. A system-prompt section is re-sent on all 76. The skill wins
by two orders of magnitude, and it is the mechanism DSH already provides for
"here is a capability, load it when relevant" — a plugin that writes its own
prompt section is duplicating that channel and paying for it on every turn.

So the cost signal lives in the skill's `description`, which is exactly what the
catalog renders (`- \`paper-search\`: <description>`, capped at 500 characters):

> FREE — no credits, no API key. Search 20 international sources … Prefer over
> billed literature tools.

The full manual — 20,000 characters of it — stays in the skill body and is only
loaded when the model calls `skill({ name: "paper-search" })`.

**In `tools: "one"` mode the catalog uses a different, shorter description.** The
file's own description is 499 characters, so appending a note about the single
`paper` tool pushed the total past the 500-character cap and DSH cut the note off
— the model never learned that `paper` exists. Single-door mode therefore
substitutes its own 319-character description, which keeps the cost signal, the
mode list, and the "not for news, docs, or general web research" boundary inside
the cap. The file's description stays authoritative for the default shape.

**Edits to `SKILL.md` reach the catalog without a restart.** The plugin watches
the skill directory and calls the registry's `invalidate()` when the file
changes; DSH caches the collected catalog by revision, so a re-read alone would
be invisible. The watcher is closed when the plugin is disposed. If the platform
cannot watch the directory, the plugin logs a warning saying a restart is needed
rather than pretending the edit took effect.

**The tradeoff, stated plainly.** The catalog is a one-time injection, so a
session that started before the plugin was installed will not see the new
description until the catalog changes. A system-prompt section would have been
live on the next request. That is the price of not paying 1,164 characters per
turn for the rest of the session.

**Why `tools: "one"` exists.** Every tool definition is sent to the model on
**every request**. Measured 24 Nov 2026, after 0.6.7:

| | characters of JSON | ≈ tokens |
|---|---|---|
| `"five"` (default) | 10,951 | ~2,738 |
| `"one"` | 6,151 | ~1,538 |
| **saved** | **44%** | ~1,200 per request |

The saving used to be 55% (10,280 / 4,651). It shrank because 0.6.6 fixed a real
defect: the merged schema used to keep only the **last** tool's description for a
shared parameter, so `sources` documented `paper_status`'s semantics instead of
`paper_search`'s, `max_results` said "default 10" where search defaults to 5,
`sort` never mentioned `relevance`, and `identifier` never mentioned `PMID` —
which `paper_detail` accepts. Those descriptions are now merged per mode
(`search: … · status: …`), and the text that was silently dropped is back.

**What it costs, stated plainly.** Tool names stop describing themselves
(`paper_fulltext` no longer exists as a name; it becomes
`paper({ mode: "fulltext" })`), and one JSON schema cannot require different
arguments per mode — so per-mode required-argument checking moves from the
harness into the plugin. `paper({ mode: "oa" })` without an `identifier` is
rejected *by the plugin*, with a message that mirrors a schema rejection, instead
of by DSH *before* the call. That is why the default stays `"five"`.

An unrecognised value falls back to `"five"` and says so in the plugin's startup
note — it is never applied silently. The option is read from the plugin's config
in your DSH profile; the shipped skill adds a short note to its own body when
`"one"` is active, so the documentation never points at a tool name that does
not exist in that profile.

## Use

```
paper_search({ query: "machine learning" })
paper_search({ query: "pendidikan karakter", sources: "indonesia" })
paper_search({ query: "CRISPR", sources: "pubmed,europepmc,doaj", max_results: 10 })
paper_search({ query: "digital literacy", open_access_only: true, year_from: 2020 })
paper_search({ query: "eye tracking", sources: "acm" })           # ACM Digital Library only
paper_status()                    # configuration only, no network (default)
paper_status({ probe: true, sources: "crossref,openalex" })  # also prove they answer
paper_detail({ identifier: "10.1145/3290605.3300233" })                     # metadata + abstract
paper_detail({ identifiers: ["10.1145/…", "PMID:37074525", "1706.03762"] }) # BATCH: 2 requests per id type
paper_citations({ identifier: "10.1145/3290605.3300233" })                  # who cites it
paper_citations({ identifier: "10.1145/3290605.3300233", direction: "references" }) # what it cites
paper_oa({ identifier: "10.1371/journal.pone.0266789" })                    # free copy?
paper_fulltext({ identifier: "1706.03762" })                                # read the whole paper
```

For Indonesian topics, **use Indonesian keywords**: `"pendidikan karakter"`
returns real Indonesian journals, while the English equivalent returns
international results that do not match the intent.

## Paper detail — metadata + abstract (OpenAlex, free)

`paper_detail` returns everything a reader needs about a paper without opening
it: title, authors **with institutions and the corresponding flag**, year/date,
venue, publisher, citation count, **FWCI** and **field percentile**, **retraction
flag**, volume/issue/pages, reference count, topics, keywords, open-access
copies with licences, and the **full abstract**.

```
paper_detail({ identifier: "10.1145/3290605.3300233" })
paper_detail({ identifier: "PMID:37074525" })
paper_detail({ identifier: "1706.03762" })                        # arXiv id
paper_detail({ identifier: "Attention Is All You Need" })         # title
paper_detail({ identifiers: ["10.1145/…", "PMID:…", "1706.03762"] })   # BATCH
paper_detail({ identifiers: [...], abstract_chars: 300 })         # shorter abstracts
```

**Why the batch matters.** One call costs **two requests per identifier TYPE**,
not one per paper: 15 DOIs cost **2** requests. The same lookup done one paper
at a time is what made a billed Semantic Scholar detail tool the most expensive
tool measured on this machine — 60 calls / 60 credits, 31% of all billed spend,
and 15 of those were consecutive calls that a single batch would have answered
for 2 credits.

> **Why two requests and not one.** OpenAlex's list endpoint **silently omits
> retracted works** unless `is_retracted:true` is in the filter, and that flag is
> **AND**-ed with the identifier filter rather than OR-ed — so neither request
> alone sees both kinds. Measured 23 Nov 2026 with one retracted and one normal
> DOI:
>
> | filter | returns |
> |---|---|
> | `doi:A\|B` | 1 work — the **normal** one |
> | `doi:A\|B,is_retracted:true` | 1 work — the **retracted** one |
>
> There are **91,863** retracted works in OpenAlex. Without the second request
> every one of them would be reported as "not found" — the worst possible error
> for this tool, because a retracted paper is exactly the paper a reader most
> needs to be warned about. The reply prints `⚠ RETRACTED` when the flag is set.

Accepted identifiers: DOI (`10.…`), `PMID:123`, `PMC123`, arXiv id
(`1706.03762`), OpenAlex id (`W…`), or a **title**. A bare number is
deliberately **not** guessed as a PMID — it is far more likely a year or a typo,
and `pmid:2024` would silently return the wrong paper.

> **What OpenAlex does NOT have** — use the Semantic Scholar tools for these:
> the S2 `paperId`/`corpusId`, **citation contexts** (the sentence that cites),
> **citation intents** (background/method/result), and SPECTER2 embeddings.
> Everything else is here.

> **"Not found in OpenAlex" does not mean the paper does not exist.** The output
> lists exactly which inputs were missing rather than silently returning a
> shorter list.

## Citation graph and open-access lookup

Two tools use OpenAlex — free, no key, no email (upstream PR #96):

- **`paper_citations`** walks the citation graph in either direction.
  `direction: "citing"` (default) lists papers that **cite** the work — forward
  snowballing; `direction: "references"` lists the works it **cites** — backward
  snowballing. The input may be a **DOI, an OpenAlex id (`W…`), or a title**.
- **`paper_oa`** reports the open-access status (gold/green/hybrid/bronze/closed)
  and every OA copy with its PDF/landing link, licence, and version. It does not
  need the Unpaywall email that the `unpaywall` source requires.

Three limits are reported rather than hidden:

1. **Title input can resolve to the wrong record.** Measured 2026-09-29: the
   title *"Attention is all you need"* resolves to `W2626778328`, a duplicate
   record with an unrelated DOI. Every output therefore names the work it
   actually used — check that before drawing conclusions.
2. **Backward snowballing reads at most 100 references** per call, so
   "most cited first" applies only among those examined.
3. **A source that fails says so.** `paper_citations`/`paper_oa` translate
   OpenAlex's 429/503/504 into an actionable sentence instead of a bare status
   code.

This plugin does **not** download PDFs for `paper_citations`/`paper_oa` — those
two only report what exists. Downloading is `paper_fulltext`'s job, below.

## Full text: open-access PDF → Markdown

`paper_fulltext` fetches the **full text** of a paper so an agent can read it,
not just its title and abstract. It accepts a DOI, an OpenAlex id (`W…`), an
**arXiv id** (`1706.03762`), or a title.

```
paper_fulltext({ identifier: "1706.03762" })                      # arXiv id
paper_fulltext({ identifier: "10.1371/journal.pone.0266789" })    # OA DOI
paper_fulltext({ identifier: "Attention Is All You Need" })       # title
paper_fulltext({ identifier: "…", force_refresh: true })            # force re-download
```

How it finds the PDF — **arXiv first**, which is upstream PR #124:

1. the work's own arXiv id (from `10.48550/arXiv.<id>` or an arXiv location), or
   else the arXiv version **looked up by title**;
2. every open-access PDF location OpenAlex reports;
3. Unpaywall, last, using the configured email.

Then the PDF is saved next to its Markdown in `~/.dsh/paper-search/md/`
(override with the `libraryRoot` plugin option), converted **locally** by
`anydoc` — fallback `markitdown` — and the tool returns the file paths, the
source it used, and either the **whole text** (when ≤ 20,000 characters) or a
preview plus the `read({ file_path, offset, limit })` call to continue with.

Measured 2026-09-29: *Attention Is All You Need* (2.1 MB PDF) → **39.8 KB of
Markdown in 424 ms**; a PLOS ONE paper (2.9 MB) → **70.8 KB in 363 ms**, with
reference links intact. End to end through the tool, including download and the
arXiv lookup: **2.4–4.4 s**, and **0.3 s** when the file already exists.

Install a converter (neither is bundled):

```sh
npm i -g @firecrawl/anydoc     # recommended: Rust binary, no Python
uv tool install markitdown     # fallback
```

`paper_status` reports which converter was found and where — **before** you hit a
failure.

### Limits that are stated, not hidden

1. **Open-access copies only.** If no legitimate free copy exists, the tool
   **fails and says so**, listing the candidates it tried. It never bypasses a
   paywall and never uses Sci-Hub or Anna's Archive.
2. **Conversion is always local.** `anydoc` has an `--ocr hosted` mode that
   uploads the document to Firecrawl; this plugin never uses it.
3. **Title lookups can pick the wrong work.** Measured: the title *"Attention is
   all you need"* resolves in OpenAlex to `W2626778328`, a duplicate record. Every
   output names the work it actually used — check it before trusting the result.
   A DOI or an arXiv id is safer.
4. **Files are never deleted for you.** The library grows ~2–3 MB per paper
   (PDF + Markdown).

## Verification status

> **Fork note.** The `test/` directory is **not** part of the published npm

> repository as of 0.6.7. Run it with `node test/run.mjs` — 24 plain `.mjs`
> files, no framework, no dependencies. On 0.6.9 **24 of 24 pass**.
>
> Each file is a regression test for a specific defect, named after it
> (`d13-slug-collision.mjs`), and each was confirmed to fail before its fix and
> pass after. The suite is cumulative, so the number that pass on an older
> baseline depends on which defects that baseline already had: on 0.6.6,
> **1 of 24** pass (the credential-seam no-regression fence, which asserts the
> plugin still loads without a seam — true before and after); on 0.6.8,
> **22 of 24** pass, because only the two 0.6.9 defects remain.
>
> The suites named in the paragraphs below are the **upstream author's**, carried
> over unchanged; they describe the **five-tool** 0.4.1 code, not this fork, and
> their files are not in this repository. What this fork *did* verify, against
> the translated code, is listed in [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md): every module
> loads, all six tools register with the renamed parameters, and
> `paper_search` / `paper_detail` (single and batch) / `paper_oa` /
> `paper_citations` (both `list` and `map`) were run against live APIs. The bug
> fixes were each confirmed with a before/after comparison against the 0.4.1

Stated precisely, because "tested" on its own is not a useful claim:

analysis: "map" })` was run on a real seed: bibliographic coupling surfaced *Questioning
the AI* (0.143), co-citation surfaced LIME's *"Why Should I Trust You?"* (cited alongside

**Verified — the connectors, against live APIs and pages.** `node test/test-sources.mjs`

That last test earned its place: it caught a fatal bug the mock never could.

## What makes the reporting honest

Every result separates **sources that failed** from sources that answered:

```
  v Crossref            3 results  (2316 ms)
  x Semantic Scholar    FAILED — HTTP 429 — {"message": "Too Many Requests...
  v Garuda              3 results  (1428 ms)
```

A source that fails is never allowed to masquerade as "no results". This is not
a detail: a widely-used tool in this space returns an empty list for *every*
non-200 response with no error recorded at all, so a rate-limited request reads
as "this literature does not exist". Here, the failure and its HTTP status are
printed, and `paper_status` exists to prove liveness on demand.

## Credentials (all optional)

No key is bundled. Read order, highest priority first:

1. **the DSH credential seam** — a key saved through the DSH configuration UI
   (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`), resolved once per tool call so a rotated key
   reaches the next call without a restart,
2. plugin config in your DSH profile,
3. environment variables `PAPER_SEARCH_MCP_<NAME>`, then `<NAME>`,
4. the file `~/.config/paper-search-mcp/.env` (belonging to the upstream CLI).

The seam is first because DSH ranks its stored file above the environment, and
because a key you saved in the UI must actually be the key in use. Layers 2–4
remain as fallbacks so a machine already configured for the upstream
`paper-search-mcp` CLI keeps working.

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `OPENALEX_API_KEY` | **the one that matters most.** Free key: 10× daily budget, 30 req/s instead of 10, and required for cursor paging. Without it OpenAlex shares one budget across everyone on your IP address |
| `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL` | any email — the Crossref/OpenAlex `mailto` contact |
| `OPENALEX_EMAIL` | same, OpenAlex only |
| `SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY` | raises Semantic Scholar rate limits |
| `DOAJ_API_KEY` | raises DOAJ's hourly limit |
| `CORE_API_KEY` | **required for the `core` source** — without it CORE answers HTTP 429 with an empty body |

Each name can be pointed at a differently-named reference with an optional config
field — `openAlexApiKeyEnv`, `semanticScholarApiKeyEnv`, `doajApiKeyEnv`,
`coreApiKeyEnv`, `unpaywallEmailEnv`, `openAlexEmailEnv` — the same lever as
`apiKeyEnv` in DSH's own LLM plugins.

A key must be printable ASCII with no space, because `fetch` cannot build an HTTP
header from anything else. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; anything else is
rejected with a message naming the reference (never the value), rather than
surfacing as an opaque 401.

### Why `OPENALEX_API_KEY` is worth setting

OpenAlex is the backend for **five** of the six tools — `paper_detail`,
`paper_citations`, `paper_oa`, `paper_fulltext`'s work lookup, and the `openalex`
/ `ssrn` / `ieee` / `biorxiv` / `medrxiv` / `chemrxiv` search sources. Its limits
are the ones you actually feel:

| | no key | free key |
|---|---|---|
| Daily budget | shared by everyone on your IP | **10×**, yours alone |
| Requests/second | 10 | **30** |
| Cursor paging | first page only | full |

# 余额徽章 · dsh-balance-pill v0.6.0 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的状态行**末尾**加一枚余额徽章：颜色随余额档位变化， 点开是充值/赠金明细、**余额趋势**、**今日已用**、**本周已用**、**近 7 天已用（含日均）**、 **最近充值**、**本轮会话消耗**与充值入口；v1.3 起徽章上还标出**当前处于高峰还是空闲计费时段** —— DeepSeek 空闲时段的单价是高峰的一半，面板因此给出两个时段的倒计时与 「等到空闲再跑能省多少」。余额掉档或时段切换时会浮出提醒，全部行为都在 「设置 → 通用设置」里调。 v0.2.0 是**审计修复版**：前后端代码完整审计后，修掉一条从 v1.4 就存在的死接线 （共享读数槽位的写入端从未被调用，看门狗的峰谷预估全部静默为空）、倒计时在 边界那一拍闪「无法估算」、上报客户端版本过期等缺陷；同时新增「最近充值」行、 「近 7 天」日均与速度行的「预计耗尽时刻」。 v0.3.0 把「账号级」做彻底：余额跨档提醒的**状态机**从此跨会话存活（此前住在 会话作用域的组件 ref 里，切换会话会重置 30 分钟冷却）；面板新增按近 7 天日均 估算的**余额跑道**；并修掉未来样本污染历史、阈值行写死 ¥、非档位刷新间隔让 下拉开天窗三处缺陷。设置键、存储键与挂载点全部不变。 v0.3.1 是**第二轮审计修复版**：修掉「近 7 天」只覆盖 8 小时的容量矛盾（历史 改为按时间抽稀，960 条覆盖满 7 天）、安装器只更新一个 profile、面板 Tab 跳出、 多窗口互相覆盖历史、每次轮询两次写盘、日历 2027 年静默失效等问题；补齐 2027 节假日数据与 `check-calendar` 维护门禁，并用有状态的测试运行时把「挂载 → 轮询 → 派生 → 卸载」真正跑进测试。设置键与挂载点不变，新增提醒状态存储键 `dsh-balance-pill:alert`（见 [0.3.1 更新内容](#031-更新内容)）。 v0.5.0 是一次**视觉与交互升级**：徽章与面板换成玻璃态，趋势区单独成卡片、悬停时在折线末端 点出当前值，统计行按时间远近递减层级，时段徽标与充值按钮重做。设置键、存储键与挂载点全部 不变；升级稿里两处「看着正常、实际不生效」的实现（字号被 `clamp` 上限卡住、端点标记画在 `

`。 ### 修复：落未来的样本（时钟回拨 / 存储写坏） 一枚**落在未来**的样本会排在历史末尾：折线在「现在」之后多出一段，且此后每次 追加都因「新样本比最后一枚更早」走进替换分支 —— 历史从此不再前进。现在加载 （`normalizeHistory`）与写入（`appendSample`）两端都拒绝比「现在」晚 5 分钟以上 （`FUTURE_SKEW_MS`）的样本；留 5 分钟是给写/读两端的时钟误差。 ### 修复：阈值行的「¥」写死了币种 阈值比较的是**当前展示币种**的金额，而面板规则行与设置说明把「¥」写死在 词条模板里 —— 美元钱包会看到「低于 ¥3 显示红色」，实际判档用的是 $3。现在 面板规则行的符号跟随当前钱包币种，设置说明改为币种中性（设置行拿不到账号 币种，不猜）。 ### 修复：非档位的刷新间隔让下拉框开天窗 存储里的 `pollMs` 允许任意 ≥5000（如 `15000`），受控下拉匹配不到选项时会渲染 成空白。`pollChoiceList(currentMs)` 把当前值动态并进选项，下拉不再开天窗。 ### 变更 - **插件图标**（`icon.svg`）：插件管理器的组合包卡片显示 `package.json.icon` 声明的图片，此前本插件一直用默认插画。 - **安装脚本**新增 `--status`（装没装 / 哪一版 / 产物是否与本地一致）；安装与 卸载前把**已装副本**也备份进 `<备份目录>/plugin`，`restore.ps1` 能把插件体 原样放回（此前只备份 profile 清单，升级失败时没有可回滚的插件体）。 - **构建脚本**新增版本一致性硬校验（package.json / version.js / CHANGELOG / lib/index.js 四处，漏改一处构建直接失败）；宿主侧入口 `lib/index.js` 新增 `version` 导出。构建期断言 40 → **46 项**，测试 142 → **151 项**。 - 设置键 / 存储键 / 挂载点**全部不变**，旧配置无需手工迁移。 ## 0.2.0 更新内容 ### 修复：共享读数槽位是死接线（审计主线缺陷） `readings.js` 在 v1.4 为时段看门狗建了「最近一次成功读数」的共享槽位：徽章写入、 看门狗读取，用于「余额够不够撑到下一个高峰」这类峰谷预估。但**写入端 `recordReading()` 从未被任何代码调用** —— `latestReading()` 恒为 null，看门狗 快照里的预估全部静默为空。徽章面板自己另算快照所以显示正常，正因为「看起来 一切正常」，这条断了的接线整整一个版本没人发现。现在每次成功读数都会写进 槽位，且 `recordReading` 被锚进构建期断言 —— 这行被删时构建直接失败。 ### 新增：面板「最近充值」行 历史里最近一次**上升**就是入账。新纯函数 `lastTopUpFromSamples()` 与 `spentFromSamples` 对称（那个只记下降、这个只看上升），同口径、同币种： ``` 近 7 天已用 ¥13.40（日均 ¥1.91，自 10-17 起） 最近充值 +¥20.00（10-22 14:03） ``` 「充的钱到账没有」是充值后第一个想确认的问题，此前要展开网页端才能看。 只读历史采样，**不新增设置项与存储键**；没有可识别的入账时不渲染。 落在 `

`。 ### 新增：「近 7 天」附带日均 + 速度行「预计耗尽时刻」 - `spendInWindow` 新增 `dailyAverage`：分母是**覆盖天数**（首末样本跨度， 不足一天按一天算），刚装插件只有两小时样本时不会被摊薄成「几乎没花」。 - 余额将在 24 小时内耗尽时，速度行追加「，约 10-24 18:32 耗尽」—— 徽章 `title` 里早有这句话（v1.4），现在不用悬停也能看到；两处共用同一个 `runoutOf()`，说法永远一致。落在 ``。 ### 修复：倒计时在边界那一拍闪「暂时无法估算」 `msUntil*` 都是 `Math.max(0, …)`，跨过边界的那一拍恰好是 0，而旧 `formatCountdown` 把 0 与 NaN 一起归进「暂时无法估算」。现在 0 按「剩余 1 秒」 显示，负数仍视为不可估算。 ### 变更：时段引擎的候选边界加单槽缓存 `pricingSnapshot` 一次要查 5 个边界问题，每次都重新生成 61 天的候选表；面板 展开时快照跟着秒级心跳走，这份重复就发生在每一秒里。现在同一计费日内共享 候选数组；**自定义日历不缓存**（两张不同的表区分不开，宁可慢也不能错， 有测试锁住）。另有：上报客户端版本对齐宿主 `0.2.1`、时段提醒设置说明改为 「每个方向每小时最多一张」（对齐 v1.5 的分方向冷却）、删除 `useBalance` 里的 死代码 `dismissAlert`。构建期断言 34 → **40** 项，测试 136 → **142** 项。 ## 0.1.6 更新内容 ### 修复：充值当天，今日/本周消耗被归零（这一版的主线） v1.5 及更早用「窗口最早金额 − 最晚金额」算消耗。只要当天充过一次值， 差额就是负数，随后被归零： ``` 08:00 ¥20 → 09:00 ¥15（花 5）→ 10:00 ¥35（充 20）→ 11:00 ¥32（花 3） 旧：20 − 32 = −12 → 0 ← 用户明明花了 ¥8 新：5 + 3 = 8 ``` 现在改为**逐段累加下降量**：相邻样本里只把下降计入消耗，充值那一跳直接跳过。 `spendInDay` / `spendInWeek` 与新增的 `spendInWindow` 共用这本账；同毫秒重复 样本会先去重，外部存储写乱的样本会先排序，避免把顺序错误当成消耗。 ### 新增：面板「近 7 天已用」 「本周已用」在周一早上只含当天，回答不了「最近一周一共花了多少」。新增一行： ``` 今日已用 ¥0.24（自 01:47 起） 本周已用 ¥1.86（自 10-13 08:20 起） 近 7 天已用 ¥3.42（自 10-11 09:10 起） ``` 与今日/本周同一套规则（同口径、同币种、逐段下降），窗口固定 7 天、跟随已有的 历史采样 —— **不新增设置项，也不新增存储键**。窗口内样本不足两个时不渲染。 落在 `

`，位置在「本周已用」之后、 趋势图之前。 ![v0.1.6 面板实测：版本号、近 7 天与跨天起点](verify/out/v016-panel-crop.png) > 真实 GUI 离屏截图（2026-10-17，本机运行中的客户端）。标题旁是 `v0.1.6`， > 「本周」与「近 7 天」的起点都带上了 `10-14` 日期，倒计时显示到分钟。 ### 修复：切换「徽章数字」口径会弹一张假的「余额不足」 从「可用合计」切到「仅充值」时，金额与档位会同时跳变；旧状态机只看金额有没有 变化，于是把新口径的较低金额当成一次真实掉档。现在每次读数带 `configKey` （口径 + 阈值 + 币种）：配置变化时静默跟随档位、不弹卡；配置稳定后真实的 掉档仍然照常提醒。 ### 修复：改阈值 / 口径后「近期消耗」整行消失 重算路径把同一份读数同时当成 `previous` 与 `summary`，`elapsed = 0`，速度必然 是 `null`。现在直接沿用上一条视图模型的速度，改设置后面板不再闪没。 ### 修复：余额暂时不变时，速度与耗尽预估消失 旧实现每次成功轮询都覆盖速度基准，下一次读数 `spent = 0` 就判定不出速度。 现在金额没变时保留旧基准，直到金额真正变化；基准最多回看 6 小时 （`RATE_MAX_ELAPSED_MS`），超过就放弃这次估算，避免把半天平均值冒充「近期速度」。 ### 修复：`null` 被当成 0（第三批） - `pricingSnapshot({balance: null})` 不再变成「余额 ¥0」并推出「撑不到下一高峰」； - `tzOffsetMinutes: null` 不再变成 UTC（整体偏 8 小时）； - `now: null` 不再落到 1970 年； - `pollMs: ''` / `false` 不再变成「仅手动」（否则插件静默停止轮询）； 数值 `0` 与 `'0'` 仍是明确的「仅手动」。 ### 修复：多日窗口的「自 HH:MM 起」读成今天 「本周已用（自 08:20 起）」在周五会被读成今天早上。新增 `formatBillingMoment()`： 同一天给 `HH:MM`，跨天补 `MM-DD`；「本周」「近 7 天」「本轮会话」都改用它。 ### 修复：跨天倒计时只显示整数天，一整天不走字 `formatCountdown` 在「天」档只返回「1 天」，而真实剩余可能是 1 天 23 小时 —— 面板看起来像冻结了。现在跨天也补上小时 / 分钟（如「1 天 2 小时 13 分钟」）， 按分钟走字；不足一小时仍按分钟 / 秒显示。 ### 变更 - **面板限高滚动**：面板按徽章上方的实际空间设置 `max-height`，内容超过时在面板 内滚动，小窗口或大字号下不会再裁掉标题与刷新按钮。 - **面板标题旁显示版本号** `v0.1.6`（`data-balance-version`），报问题时不用再猜。 - 构建期产物断言从 26 项增至 **34 项**；测试从 126 项增至 **136 项**。 - **版本号重置**：`package.json` / `CHANGELOG.md` / `PLUGIN_VERSION` 三处一致， 设置键、存储键、挂载点与已有配置全部不变，升级无需迁移。 ## v1.5 更新内容 ### 修复：时段提醒的冷却会把反方向的卡片挡掉（这一版的主线） v1.4 及更早的时段提醒状态机只有一个 `alertedAt`，所有方向的提醒共用同一小时冷却。 于是这个时序会被静默吞掉一张卡： ``` 11:30 进入高峰 → 提醒（alertedAt = 11:30） 12:00 进入空闲 → 距上次提醒仅 30 分钟 < 1 小时冷却 → 被挡掉 ``` 而「现在便宜了」恰恰是用户最想看到的那张卡 —— 高峰时段里用户正在花钱，等到 12:00 忽然半价，这是唯一值得主动告诉他的时刻。 现在冷却**按方向分账**：`alertedAtPeak` 与 `alertedAtOffPeak` 各走各的窗口， 一个方向提醒过不影响另一个方向。旧字段 `alertedAt` 仍然写回（保留向后兼容）， 但不再参与判定。 | 规则 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | 同方向连续切换 | 仍受 1 小时冷却保护（不会连环弹卡） | | 反方向切换 | **不受**另一方向的冷却影响，该提醒就提醒 | | 冷却期内 | 原样保留状态、不推进 period —— 冷却一过就补上，切换不会被永久吞掉 | ### 修复：`null` / 空串被当成合法的 0 阈值 `normalizeSettings()` 的 `numberOr()` 直接 `Number(value)`，而 `Number(null)`、 `Number('')`、`Number(false)` 全都是 `0`，能通过 `Number.isFinite` 与 `>= 0` 两道检查。 后果是**任何余额都判红**：用户把设置里的阈值输入框清空，徽章立刻变成「余额不足」， 而界面上看不出任何异常。 现在只接受数字，或**非空**的数字字符串，其余一律回落默认值。这与 v1.4 修 `billingDayOf`（`Number(null)` 是 1970-01-01）、v1.3 修 `tariffEpochOf` 是同一条教训： **`null` 不是 `0`**。 ### 新增：面板「本周已用」 「今日已用」回答「今天花了多少」，「本轮会话」回答「这次对话花了多少」， 但没有一行回答「这周一共」—— 而周一对账正是最需要它的时候。 ``` 本轮会话已用 ¥0.99（自 15:42 起） 今日已用 ¥0.24（自 01:47 起） 本周已用 ¥1.86（自 10-13 08:20 起） ``` 与「今日已用」同一套四条规则（只算同周、只算同口径 `basis`、只算同币种、差额为负 时归零；v0.1.6 起改为「逐段下降求和」，充值不再把已花掉的钱归零），只是按 **北京时间 ISO 周**（周一为起点）切分。历史最长保留 7 天，所以 「本周」在周日晚上与「最近 7 天」几乎重合；周一早上则只含周一当天 —— 这正是它 存在的意义：**周一对账不需要看上周**。 当天样本不足两个时**不渲染这一行**（而不是显示 ¥0）。 ### 新增：「近期消耗」标明按哪个时段折算 跨高峰/空闲切换时这个数会跳变（同样的钱在空闲时段能用两倍时长），不标注会让用户 以为是余额算错了。空闲时段现在用独立文案： ``` 近期消耗 -¥1.20（空闲价），按此速度约可用 7.5 小时 ``` ### 变更 - **「本轮会话已用」的时刻写法改为「自 HH:MM 起」**（与「今日已用」「本周已用」统一）： 「3 分钟前」这类相对写法每秒都在贬值，而「从几点开始」是稳定的。 - 构建期产物断言从 19 项增至 **26 项**；新增 `alertedAtPeak` / `alertedAtOffPeak` 两条尤其值得锚住 —— 退回单一 `alertedAt` 时功能看起来完全正常，只有特定时序才露馅。 - 设置键与存储键**全部不变**，**没有新增设置项**（「本周已用」跟随已有历史采样， 分方向冷却是内部实现），旧配置无需手工迁移。 - 测试套件**按源码重建**（126 个用例）。原 `tests/runtime.test.mjs` 在本次会话开始时 已损坏到不可恢复（672 行被写成 `U+FFFD`、316 处行尾注释吞掉了自己的换行符）， 修复过程中又被零填充成 NUL 字节。原委与重建范围写在 [`CHANGELOG.md` 的 1.5.0 一节](CHANGELOG.md#150)，这里不重复。 **源码模块与 `verify/out/` 的截图未受影响**（已全库扫描确认）。 ## v1.4 更新内容 ### 修复：看门狗从时钟跳变中自愈（这一版的主线） v1.3 的 166 项单测与构建**全绿**，但真实 GUI 验证台报出「进入空闲」方向的提醒卡 75 秒内一张都没出现。逐层排查（只读探针直接读组件的 fiber props）确认了根因： > 看门狗由 `setInterval(run, 30000)` 驱动，而 effect 的依赖是 `[settings, tariff]` > 两个**恒定引用** —— 于是「时钟前进」本身永远不触发重算。注入 12:30 后 75 秒内 > `tariff.latest().now` **冻在 10:30**；手动调一次 `tick()` 立刻产出正确卡片。 > **状态机是对的，错的是宿主侧那层驱动。** 这不只是验证台才有的问题 —— 真实用户会遇到同一个形状：笔记本**合盖唤醒**、 **NTP 校时**、**后台标签页被节流**，都会让时钟跨过时段边界而看门狗毫不知情， 本该提醒你的那次「进入高峰」被静默吞掉。 现在改成**自愈的链式调度**： | 机制 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `nextTickDelay()` 重排下一次唤醒 | **对齐到下一个时段边界**（边界都是整点，可预知），提醒准时且不更费 CPU | | `visibilitychange` / `focus` 立即补一拍 | 覆盖休眠唤醒与切回标签页 | | `drift()` + `TARIFF_MAX_GAP_MS`（2×tick） | 识别时钟跳变；跳变**不改变状态机的推进**，于是跳变后的**第一拍**就补上卡片 | 实测：一次性把时钟从 14:30 推到 19:00（跨过 18:00 边界）， `drift().jumped=true` 且「进入空闲」卡片出现。 ### 修复：另外两条 - **改「时段切换提醒」开关不能立刻生效**：提醒宿主的 effect 依赖是 store 对象本身 （引用恒定），而 v1.3 的契约里写着「也由它负责在设置变化时 tick」—— 这句话直到 v1.4 补断言，能挡住手抄错误）； 3. 面板会自动显示新的覆盖年份 —— 不需要改文案。 ## 效果 徽章落在状态行**最右端**（宿主上下文环 `59%` 之后），颜色随余额档位变化： | 档位 | 触发条件（默认） | 颜色 | 附加表现 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `low` 余额不足 | 可用合计 < **¥3** | 红（主题 `state-error` 令牌） 高峰时多一行「跑 2 小时省多少」，空闲时多一行「够不够撑到下一个高峰」， 面板底部还有一行日历覆盖提示。其中「本段空闲：{from} – {to}（共 {duration}）」 给的是**整段**区间的长度，不是「从现在起还剩多久」；跨天时结束时刻带上日期 （如「18:00 – 10-16 09:00」）。v1.3 的实测结论见 [`verify/V13-EVIDENCE.md`](verify/V13-EVIDENCE.md)，v1.4 的见 [`verify/V14-EVIDENCE.md`](verify/V14-EVIDENCE.md)。 「本轮会话已用」与「今日已用」（v1.4）是两条互补的信息：前者按**会话**算 （这次对话花了多少），后者按**计费日**算（今天一共花了多少）。两条都要求历史里 至少有两个可用样本，刚打开页面时都不会出现。 ## 数据来源与安全 - 余额**不是**本插件去开放平台取的。宿主已挂载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platform`，并通过 Typert Remote 把 `account` 命名空间暴露给渲染层；客户端只调用： ```js ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds }) // → { ok: true, value: { status: 'ready', value: [充值钱包], bonusWallets: [赠金钱包] } } // | { ok: true, value: null } // 未登录 / 凭据已切换 // | { ok: false, error } // 读取失败（宿主保留凭据） ``` - **凭据不出宿主进程**：账号 token 只存在于宿主，客户端拿到的是脱敏后的 钱包投影（币种 + 余额字符串）。 - 插件只做只读查询；渲染层不改账号状态，也不触碰推理请求。 - 只 require 平台种子表里的模块（`react` / `react-dom` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，后者只用于取宿主 `Toast`， 取不到会退回自带卡片），不引入任何第三方依赖。 - 计费时段与节假日日历是**离线**判定：内置固定 +08:00 偏移与静态日历表， 不联网、不读机器时区。 - 配置、历史、会话基准与提醒状态都存在浏览器 `localStorage`，不上传： `dsh-balance-pill:settings`、`dsh-balance-pill:history`、`dsh-balance-pill:sessions`、 `dsh-balance-pill:alert`。任何一层读写失败都只影响该层，不影响余额读取本身。 ## 安装 / 卸载 ```powershell cd D:\Questions\dsh-balance-pill node scripts/build.mjs # 生成 client/client.js node scripts/install.mjs # 预览要改什么（默认不写盘，遍历所有 profile） node scripts/install.mjs --apply # 安装（每个 profile 先备份） node scripts/install.mjs --status # 全部 profile：装没装 / 哪一版 / 产物是否一致 node scripts/install.mjs --profile=web --apply # 只处理指定的 profile ``` - 卸载：`node scripts/install.mjs --apply --uninstall` - 回滚：安装时会写 `/dsh-balance-pill-backup-<时间戳>//restore.ps1`； 多 profile 时另生成 `restore-all.ps1`。v0.3.0 起已安装的插件副本也进备份 （`/plugin`），回滚脚本会把插件体原样放回。 - 改完前端源码后热更新：`node scripts/build.mjs; node scripts/install.mjs --sync-client --apply` （`dsh-client-hmr` 每 500ms 轮询已安装的 `client.js`，约 1 秒后界面自动替换） - 发版前日历门禁：`npm run check:calendar`（缺当前年份或下一年安排时退出码 1）。 **首次安装需要刷新一次页面**：客户端插件图在页面加载时组成，已经打开的窗口不会 自动知道多了一行。之后的所有更新都是热替换，不需要刷新。 **从 v1.0 ～ v1.5 升级到 0.1.6**：无需手工迁移。阈值会从 v1.0 的 `dsh-balance-pill:thresholds` 自动迁移且不删旧键；历史与会话基准是 v1.2 新增的， 首次运行时为空，用一会儿就会画出趋势；v1.3 的三个新设置项在旧配置里缺省， 读取时各自回落到默认值（徽标开、口径 `deepseek-flash`、时段提醒关）。 **v1.4 / v1.5 / v0.1.6 / v0.2.0 / v0.3.0 都没有新增设置项与存储键**（「今日已用」 「本周已用」「近 7 天已用」「最近充值」「余额跑道」都跟随已有的历史采样）， 因此升级不需要任何操作。0.3.0 起升级前可用 `node scripts/install.mjs --status` 先看一眼已装副本的版本与产物一致性。**0.3.1 / 0.5.0 / 0.5.1 同样只改实现与样式**： 没有新增或改名任何设置项与存储键，已存的历史、会话基准与提醒状态都照旧读取。 **0.6.0 起历史、会话基准与提醒状态按账号隔离**；设置仍全局共享，旧全局派生键保留但不再读取。 ## 配置 设置面板是首选路径。想直接改存储或写脚本时： ```js // 浏览器控制台 / DevTools localStorage.setItem('dsh-balance-pill:settings', alertOnTariff: false // v1.3：时段切换提醒（默认关） })) ``` 任何一项非法都只回落该项默认值；`low` / `warn` 写反会被对调， `format` / `currency` / `tariffModel` 不在白名单会回默认，`pollMs` 非数字或过密 会被纠正，两个新开关不是布尔值就回默认。 ## 项目结构 ``` evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# webrain for DeepSeek Harness A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) bundle that connects [webrain](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain)'s Model Context Protocol server. Every webrain tool becomes callable by the agent as `mcp__webrain__` — 19 tools for real-Chrome navigation, challenge-aware scraping, extraction, crawling, screenshots, PDFs, and search. ```text webrain MCP (stdio: `webrain mcp`) │ tools/list, tools/call ▼ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client → ctx.tools → mcp__webrain__webrain_navigate ``` ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` package. Every shipped profile provides it. - The `webrain` binary on the `PATH` of the process that starts the harness: - Windows: `scoop install webrain` - macOS: `brew install prokopis3/webrain/webrain` - anywhere else: a binary from [Releases](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain/releases) - `webrain --version` must work from the shell that starts the harness. - A browser engine, once: `webrain install` downloads Chrome for Testing into webrain's engine cache. Without it, navigation fails with an engine error even though the tool list is complete. `webrain doctor` diagnoses both. ## Install In the Web UI: **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, paste a spec from below or choose the bundle directory. From a shell: ```bash # The npm registry, once the package is published # (the Publish dsh-webrain workflow does that at each release tag): dsh plugin --profile add dsh-webrain # A pinned commit of this repository. pnpm 11 or newer is required for a Git # subdirectory install; the parameters are separated with npm's "::" form # because pnpm 11 rejects the "&path:" spelling it documents. dsh plugin --profile add \ 'github:prokopis3/webrain#::path:integrations/dsh-webrain' # A checkout on this machine: dsh plugin --profile add 'D:\path\to\webrain\integrations\dsh-webrain' ``` `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm, so the verb is `add` (not `install`), and installing a package into a profile that is a pnpm workspace root can need `ignore-workspace-root-check=true` in `$DSH_HOME/profiles//.npmrc`. A live profile picks the bundle up without a restart. ## What appears - A bundle card named **webrain browser tools**, with its own icon and the plugin name `webrain`. - One enabled row: **MCP client** (row id `webrain-mcp`, `serverName: webrain`). `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` owns that row's title and generic artwork — the webrain icon belongs to the bundle card. - The tools `mcp__webrain__webrain_navigate`, `mcp__webrain__webrain_extract`, `mcp__webrain__webrain_batch`, `mcp__webrain__webrain_observe`, `mcp__webrain__webrain_guide`, and the rest of webrain's 19-tool surface. ## Verify 1. **Plugins** shows the *webrain browser tools* bundle and one enabled **MCP client** row. 2. Ask the agent to call `mcp__webrain__webrain_guide`. It returns webrain's browser/challenge/extraction decision guide. 3. Then a real task: > Call `mcp__webrain__webrain_guide`, then open `https://example.com` and > extract the heading. ## Configuration The bundle inserts a row with id `webrain-mcp`. Override it with an `id`-targeted patch in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`); restate the whole `config`, because a patch replaces it wholly. With `patchReload: live` the change applies without a restart: ```yaml - id: webrain-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: webrain transport: stdio command: '/opt/homebrew/bin/webrain' # absolute path for GUI launches args: ['mcp'] env: CDP_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:9222' # reuse an already-open Chrome WEBRAIN_PROFILES_DIR: '/Users/me/Library/Application Support/webrain/profiles' toolCallTimeoutMs: 600000 # default from the bundle: 300000 startupTimeoutMs: 60000 failOnStartupError: true ``` An absolute `command` matters on macOS when the harness is launched from Finder: a GUI process sees a minimal `PATH`, so a Homebrew `webrain` is invisible. One `serverName` can be registered once per scope. If you also keep a hand-written `webrain` MCP entry (for example the HTTP form, `webrain mcp --http 9223`), disable or remove it — otherwise the bundle's row fails with `mcp-client: serverName "webrain" is already in use by another mcp-client instance`. ## What it touches - The harness spawns one `webrain mcp` child process and speaks JSON-RPC over its stdio. webrain's logs go to stderr. - webrain keeps its own browser profiles and engine cache in the platform data and cache directories (`…/webrain/profiles`, `…/webrain/browsers`), overridable with `WEBRAIN_PROFILES_DIR` / `WEBRAIN_BROWSERS_DIR`; `webrain help env` lists every variable. Nothing is stored in the harness profile. - Browsers, cookies, and screenshots stay on this machine. Pages are fetched only when a tool asks for a URL. - Uninstalling the bundle, or turning it off, unregisters the tools and stops the child process. It does not delete webrain's browser profiles or engines. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause | Fix | |---|---|---| | The **MCP client** row fails, no `mcp__webrain__*` tools | `webrain` is not on the harness's `PATH` | set an absolute `command`, or start the harness from a shell where `webrain --version` works; the Host log names the spawn failure | | `mcp-client: serverName "webrain" is already in use by another mcp-client instance` | another MCP row uses `serverName: webrain` | disable or remove that row | | `'pnpm' is not recognized` while installing | the harness process has no `pnpm` | install pnpm for the user that runs the harness, then retry | | `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT` while installing | the profile is a pnpm workspace root and pnpm refuses the add | add `ignore-workspace-root-check=true` to the profile's `.npmrc`, then retry | | Tool calls time out on heavy pages | the default call budget is below the page's cost | raise `toolCallTimeoutMs` on the `webrain-mcp` row | | Navigation fails with a missing browser/engine | `webrain install` never ran | run `webrain install`, then `webrain doctor` | | `webrain_navigate` returns `challenge` | the page is gated | use real Chrome: `webrain launch ` then `webrain login`, or point `CDP_URL` at that Chrome | ## Related - `docs/mcp/deepseek-harness.mdx` — the user-facing guide in the webrain docs. - `skills/webrain/SKILL.md` — webrain's operator skill for any MCP client. - `docs/AGENT_DECISION_GUIDE.md` — which webrain tool for which task. ## License MIT, the same license as webrain.
# WebRain **A portable, LLM-driven browser-automation & web-scraping MCP server — one binary, three engines, any OS.** WebRain exposes 19 intent-based tools over the **Model Context Protocol**. Install it on any system, point any LLM client (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex, Cursor, …) at it, and the model decides everything — search, crawl, scrape, navigate, interact — from a plain-language prompt. No hardcoded intent detection, no daemon, no Node.js. [![Latest Release](https://badgen.net/github/release/prokopis3/webrain?icon=github)](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Linux%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Windows-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain/releases) [![Last Commit](https://badgen.net/github/last-commit/prokopis3/webrain/main?icon=github)](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain/commits/main) [![GitHub Stars](https://badgen.net/github/stars/prokopis3/webrain?icon=github)](https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain/stargazers) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.94+-orange.svg)](Cargo.toml)
--- ## Why webrain? Web automation shouldn't mean wiring up a driver, a browser download, and your own tool wrappers before an LLM can touch a page. Webrain collapses that into **one binary + one install command** and speaks MCP, so any LLM client drives it directly. | | **webrain** | Raw Playwright / Puppeteer | |---|---|---| | **Setup** | one binary + `webrain install` | runtime + driver + browser download + your own wrappers | | **Browsers** | Chrome + lightpanda + obscura through one CDP backend | one engine, usually Chromium | | **LLM-ready** | MCP server, 19 tools, built-in decision guide | you hand-roll tool functions | | **Anti-bot** | challenge detection + persistent profile + native login | manual | | **Extraction** | autoschema → JSON / regex / table / spider / batch | you write selectors | | **Runs on** | any OS, any LLM client, or plain CLI | tied to your stack | ## What you can do with it - **Scrape at scale** — `webrain_batch` runs one op across many URLs in parallel tabs; `webrain_crawl` handles spider / sitemap / infinite-scroll / URL-validation, both with auto-throttle and checkpoint-resume. - **Structured data without hand-written selectors** — `webrain_extract` mode `autoschema` proposes the repeated container, then `schema` / `regex` / `table` / `jsonld` read it. All zero-LLM. - **Stealth login** — real-Chrome profiles with an encrypted local credential vault (AES-256-GCM + optional TOTP), plus cookie transfer across engines. - **Get past challenges** — every `webrain_navigate` reports a `challenge` field; protected sites clear with real Chrome + a persistent profile + native login. Native CAPTCHA/vision v2 (drag, `eval_in_frame`, vision ask) — no Python sidecar. - **See the page** — `webrain_observe` (state / a11y / semantic tree) plus vision tiles (screenshot → vector store) for tables and charts. - **Structured search** — `webrain_serp` returns typed JSON (`position`/`title`/`url`/`domain`/`snippet`), deduped and paginated, across provider tiers: free HTTP engines → Brave API key → browser render → serpapi. - **Read anything** — `webrain_pdf` (extract + render), JSON-LD, media, plus `webrain_scrape` for static pages over plain HTTP with no browser process at all. - **Talk to it, and watch it work** — `webrain chat` drives all of the above from your own model key; `chat --serve` puts that turn in a page with tool cards you can re-run, model-written follow-up chips, conversation totals, and replies that can be laid out as cards or tables instead of prose. See [Chat](#chat). --- ## Prerequisites - **OS**: Windows, macOS, or Linux (x86_64 / arm64). - **A browser engine** — run `webrain install` once (downloads Chrome for Testing). Obscura and Lightpanda are optional extra engines. - **Linux**: system libraries for Chrome — see [installation](docs/installation.mdx#linux-dependencies). - **Docker** — only to run the obscura / lightpanda engines in containers. - **An MCP-capable client** (VS Code + Copilot, Claude, Codex, Cursor, …) — optional; the CLI works standalone. - **For `webrain chat`** — the Copilot runtime first (`webrain install copilot`), then a model key. See [Chat](#chat). ## Installation > Install model mirrors [vercel-labs/agent-browser](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser): a native binary plus an `install` command that downloads engines into a cache dir. ### Global Installation (recommended) One command installs `webrain` on your PATH: **Linux / macOS:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prokopis3/webrain/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prokopis3/webrain/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` Then download a browser engine once — `webrain install` — and follow [Run it](#run-it). ### Other install paths Homebrew, Scoop, `cargo install`, a manual binary download, and a from-source build are all covered in [docs/installation.mdx](docs/installation.mdx), together with the Linux system libraries Chrome needs. ### From Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain cd webrain cargo build --release --bin webrain --features pdfium # what the release builds ./target/release/webrain install # Download Chrome (first time only) ./target/release/webrain mcp --http 9223 ``` `--features pdfium` enables `pdf_render` (it binds the system pdfium at runtime, so `webrain install pdfium` still supplies the library). Add `,chat` for [`webrain chat`](docs/guides/chat.mdx) — that pulls a ~135 MB Copilot runtime and needs OS OpenSSL 3 on Linux, so it is opt-in; needs Rust 1.94+. **Not available on a static musl target**: `copilot-sdk` 2.0.1 refuses a vendored OpenSSL and requires `OPENSSL_STATIC=0`, so a static-pie binary cannot carry it — the musl builds ship every tool except chat. ### Updating Upgrade to the latest version: ```bash webrain upgrade ``` Detects your installation method (Homebrew, Scoop, or a manual install) and updates automatically — `brew upgrade webrain`, `scoop update webrain`, or self-updates the binary in place. If installed via cargo: ```bash cargo install --git https://github.com/prokopis3/webrain webrain-cli --force ``` Re-download engines after an update (cache dir stays, versions are additive): ```bash webrain install webrain install --engine obscura ``` ### OS Compatibility Every engine, per OS: | Engine | Windows | macOS | Linux | |---|---|---|---| | **Chrome for Testing** (`webrain install`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Obscura** (`webrain install --engine obscura`) | ✅ x86_64 | ✅ x86_64 / arm64 | ✅ x86_64 / arm64 | | **Lightpanda** (`webrain lightpanda`, binary needed) | ⚠️ (needs a Windows build on PATH) | ✅ | ✅ | | **Docker** (`docker/Dockerfile`) | via Docker Desktop | via Docker Desktop | ✅ | Binary discovery is automatic on every OS: env override → PATH → `~/.lightpanda`, `~/.obscura`, `~/.local/bin` → the webrain engine cache. ## Run it ```bash webrain install # 1. one browser engine (Chrome for Testing) webrain doctor # 2. verify: engines, CDP ports, vault, MCP webrain mcp # 3. MCP over stdio (VS Code, Claude, Cursor, …) webrain mcp --http 9223 # …or HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:9223/mcp ``` Register that server in your client (see *Marketplace / IDE Plugins* below), then just ask: **“scrape every product title and price from ”**. Prefer the CLI? `webrain launch` gives you headed Chrome with a persistent profile, and every MCP tool has a command twin — see [Commands](#commands). ### Selecting elements The MCP tools drive elements by **index**, not by CSS selector: `webrain_navigate` / `webrain_observe` return the interactive elements (`a, button, input, select, textarea, [role=button]`) and `webrain_interact` takes that index — `{"action": "click", "index": 3}`. The CLI uses the same 1-indexed refs: ```bash webrain launch # guest-mode Chrome (no profile state) webrain fetch https://example.com # prints the page text + interactive elements webrain click 3 # click element #3 webrain type 5 "text" # type into element #5 webrain eval 'document.querySelector("#email").value' ``` ## Commands ```bash webrain mcp [--http ] # MCP server (stdio, or HTTP on a port) webrain doctor # diagnose the install (engines, MCP, CDP, vault) webrain install [--engine chrome|obscura] [--stealth] # download a browser engine webrain upgrade # update to the latest release webrain launch [url] # stealth Chrome, persistent profile webrain login [url] # interactive login into a profile webrain vault set|list|user|rm # encrypted credential vault (AES-256-GCM + TOTP) webrain cookies / setcookies # export / import cookies webrain fetch # attach to CDP_URL and fetch webrain screenshot # full-page screenshot (always full page) webrain spider [--depth N --pages N --respect-robots] # crawl webrain click / type / eval # drive the CDP_URL backend webrain tool '' [--url U] # ANY of the 19 MCP tools, no model needed webrain read [--browser|--outline|--filter T] # a page as markdown (HTTP; --browser for a host that refuses it) webrain pdf [--json] # PDF text as markdown (no browser) webrain obscura / lightpanda [--port N] # spawn a CDP server webrain watch [--vision] # transcript + frames (no browser) webrain install watch|whisper [--model NAME] # ffmpeg + yt-dlp + whisper (STT) webrain install vision [--model ID] [--model-update] # llama-server + a local vision model webrain uninstall vision --model ID | --all # remove installed vision models webrain serp "" [--engine …] [--limit N] # structured JSON search (7 engines + auto) webrain diff [--max N] [--json] # what changed between two pages (exit 1 if so) webrain chat "" [--provider P] [--search] # one agent turn on your own model key ``` The 19-tool MCP surface is discovered dynamically — `webrain_guide` lists it for the LLM (see [MCP Tools](#mcp-tools)) — and `webrain tool` runs any one of them from a shell, so an extraction or a network log needs no model and no key. ## Chat `webrain chat` is the built-in agent: one Copilot turn on **your own model key**, with this binary's own MCP tools attached, so the turn can actually navigate, extract and screenshot. `chat --serve` puts the same turn in a browser page — threads, a turn ledger, dictation and image attachments. Install it in three steps. The Copilot runtime is **not** embedded in the release binary, so chat does not start without the first: ```bash webrain install copilot # 1. the Copilot runtime chat drives (~135 MB, SHA-256 verified) webrain install chat-ui # 2. the page `chat --serve` serves (digest-verified) webrain install # 3. a browser engine, so the tools can drive a real page export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=… # or any of the 16 provider rows webrain chat "what does news.ycombinator.com say today?" webrain chat --serve # browser UI on http://127.0.0.1:8787/ ``` - **Keys**: 16 BYOK providers, one key is enough — `--provider` / `--model` pick the row, `--key-from VAR` and `--base-url` cover anything else, and `WEBRAIN_CHAT_API_KEY` works for any row. `webrain help env` lists the ambient names. - **Tools need approval**: reads and navigation run; writes and clicks need `--yes` (the `--serve` page asks instead). - `COPILOT_CLI_PATH` points chat at a Copilot CLI you already have. Chat keeps its own `COPILOT_HOME` and never reads `~/.copilot`. - `webrain install chat-ui` from a *different* version is refused, not served — upgrade the binary and the page together. - From source it is opt-in: `cargo build --release --features chat` (Rust 1.94+; Linux needs OS OpenSSL 3, which is why the static musl builds leave chat out; `chat-bundled` embeds the runtime). Every release binary carries it except the two `*-linux-*-musl` ones. ### What the page does that a terminal does not ![A turn in webrain chat: the prompt, the answer streaming in, the turn footer and three follow-up chips](docs/images/chat-turn.gif) *One turn, recorded: the prompt, the answer arriving, the closing `… · 0 steps · 6.2s` line and the three follow-up chips the model wrote.* ![An html-mode answer: a dashboard of cards, stats, pills and a progress bar](docs/images/chat-html-answer.png) *The same page in `html` mode, where an answer can be a dashboard rather than prose.* - **The reply can be laid out, not just written.** Settings → Chat switches rendering between `markdown` and a sanitised **HTML5 fragment**. In `html` mode the model is told which shapes the page styles — a short answer is a paragraph, comparable items are `div.grid > section.card`, a number worth reading is `div.stat`, a comparison is a table — so "design it" is not something you have to ask for; ask a comparison question and it comes back as cards. `

# dsh-analytics

PSPP 作为 DeepSeek Harness 插件自带引擎的统计分析工作台：**不连接系统里另装的 PSPP**，插件目录里自带一份可搬迁的 PSPP 引擎（`engine/<平台>-<架构>/`，本机 `engine/linux-x64/` 23 MB，已实测在屏蔽 `/usr/lib64/pspp` 与 `/usr/share/pspp` 后仍能运行）。

界面在 DSH 原生右侧栏里以 **统计分析** 标签页出现（通过 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的 `registerTab` 注册），按 SPSS 的操作范式组织：菜单栏 + 工具栏 + 数据视图 / 变量视图 / 语法 / 输出查看器 + 分析对话框。名字里的 analytics 说的是用途，真正干活的是自带的 GNU PSPP 引擎。

## 界面

以下截图取自 Windows 10 上的真实 DSH（暗色皮肤），面板本身跟随宿主主题。

| 输出查看器（含表注与图） | 数据视图 |
| --- | --- |
| ![输出查看器](docs/screenshots/panel-output.png) | ![数据视图](docs/screenshots/panel-data.png) |

| 分析对话框（描述统计） | 报告成册生成的 HTML（封面 + 目录） |
| --- | --- |
| ![描述统计对话框](docs/screenshots/dialog-descriptives.png) | ![报告成册](docs/screenshots/report-book.png) |

更多界面图（菜单、各类对话框、图表、值标签等）在 [docs/screenshots](docs/screenshots)。

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **>= 0.2.0**（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 声明了这个范围；低于它的宿主会在安装时就拒绝）
- Node.js **>= 20**（插件零运行时依赖；`npm test` 是自带脚本 + `node:assert`，其中 smoke/routes 两套要能跑起 PSPP 引擎）
- 一个带 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的 profile：侧栏页签靠它的 `registerTab` 注册，`peerDependencies` 里是可选依赖
- 引擎：插件自带预编译 PSPP，**不需要**系统装 PSPP；本机平台没有 `engine/<platform>-<arch>/` 时按 `npm run engine:fetch` 从 `engine-v*` Release 拉，或回退到系统 `pspp`

面板支持中文与英文两套界面（设置 → 统计分析 → 界面语言），分析输出的表头与数据值保持原样。

## 安装

包自带 `engine/linux-x64` 与 `engine/win32-x64`（约 34 MB），一条命令装（0.27.0 起）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/qzhengpyuan/dsh-analytics.git && cd dsh-analytics
node scripts/install.mjs web            # 下最新 Release 的 .tgz、按 SHA256SUMS 校验、打印要执行的两步
node scripts/install.mjs web --apply    # 真的装：装进 profile + 把 dsh-analytics-pspp 加进 dsh.profile.bundles
# 之后：设置 → 插件 → dsh-analytics 关一次再开
```

- 仓库已公开（2026-11-18 起），一条命令安装不再需要 token；脚本仍会在有 `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs.GITHUB_TOKEN` 时带上它（撞上 GitHub 的匿名限流时更稳）。
- 走代理时加 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`（Node 的 `fetch` 默认不读 `https_proxy`）。
- 想手动装：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:<tgz>`，再把 `"dsh-analytics"` 加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
- 这个包**没有发到 npm**：`dsh-analytics` 这个名字在 npm 上已被别的包占用（0.4.0），换名字只会把文档拆成两份。

`linux-x64` 与 `win32-x64` 是实测平台；`linux-arm64`、`darwin-arm64`、`darwin-x64` 的引擎在 `engine-v1` 里有 CI 产物，但**没有真机验证**。细节与检查清单见 [docs/install.md](docs/install.md)。

## 它由两半组成

| 半边 | 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js`、`lib/*.js` | 自带引擎的进程管理、每会话工作区、数据读写、输出解析、`/analytics` HTTP API，并把工作区注册成 `analytics` 服务 |
| 预设半 | `tools-entry.js` | 27 个 `pspp_*` 工具，只挂在「统计分析」Agent 预设里，别的会话拿不到 |
| Client | `client.js` | 通过 `ctx.betterSidebar.registerTab()` 注册侧栏页签；所有请求走同一套 API |

面板的设置页（设置 → 统计分析）管个案上限、超时、`--safer` 与表格样式，写 `~/.dsh/analytics/settings.json`，不用改 profile patch；`registerTools` 那一项仍属部署决定，只展示。

Host 与 UI 共用**同一组 `Workspace` 方法**，所以"用户在对话框点确定"和"模型在对话里调 `pspp_analyze`"执行的是同一条代码路径，状态不会分叉。

## 引擎

- 目录布局：`engine/<process.platform>-<process.arch>/{bin,libexec,lib}`，每个平台一份预编译产物；`bin/` 是设好动态库搜索路径的启动器，`libexec/` 是真正的二进制
- 解析顺序：`config.engineDir` → 环境变量 `DSH_ANALYTICS_ENGINE`（旧名 `DSH_ANALYTICS_PSPP_ENGINE` 仍认）→ 包内 `engine/<平台>-<架构>/` → 包内扁平 `engine/` → 系统 `pspp`；动态库变量按平台选（Linux `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`、macOS `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH`、Windows `PATH`）
- 生成：`npm run engine:fetch`（从 `engine-v*` Release 拉本机平台那份，需要时用 `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）、`node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs --from-prefix <prefix> --platform linux-x64`（导入容器里 configure 出来的 prefix），或 `npm run bundle-engine`（从本机 `dnf install pspp` 直接抓）
- **`engine/` 不进 Git**（二进制）：克隆后按需重建；运行插件本身不需要系统装 PSPP
- 打包时**跳过 glibc 家族**（libc/libm/libpthread/…）改用宿主 glibc：把发行版 glibc 塞进 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 在别的系统上会直接崩。所以引擎的最低 glibc = **构建机**的 glibc；仓库里的这份是在 **AlmaLinux 8（glibc 2.28）** 上重编的，覆盖 RHEL/Alma/Rocky 8+、Ubuntu 18.10+、Debian 10+、openSUSE Leap 15+（旧版 Fedora 44 编译产物要求 2.43，仅 Fedora 44 能跑，已弃用）
- 引擎能力：PSPP 2.1.3 的实现范围（`FREQUENCIES` `DESCRIPTIVES` `CROSSTABS` `T-TEST` `ONEWAY` `GLM` `CORRELATIONS` `REGRESSION` `LOGISTIC REGRESSION` `FACTOR` `RELIABILITY` `NPAR TESTS` `EXAMINE` `MEANS` `CTABLES` `ROC` `QUICK CLUSTER`、数据管理与宏、`GRAPH /BAR` `/HISTOGRAM` `/SCATTERPLOT`），以及任意 `pspp_run` 语法
- 已知 PSPP 缺口（插件无法提供）：`DISCRIMINANT` `GGRAPH` `UNIANOVA/MANOVA` `MIXED` `SURVIVAL/KM` `TREE/CHAI` `REPORT` `MDS/PROXSCAL` `TWOSTEP` `CORRESPONDENCE` `PPLOT`，图表缺少 `PIE`/`LINE`

## 图表

条形图 / 直方图 / 散点图 / 箱线图 / 折线图 / 饼图**不由 PSPP 出图**：插件用内存里的数据集自己聚合（均值/总和/计数、等宽分箱、抽样），再由 `lib/charts.js` 渲染成 SVG 存进运行目录（`runs/<n>/chart.svg` + `chart.json`），面板与 agent 拿到的是同一张矢量图。

- 箱线图带五数概括、1.5×IQR 须线与离群点；折线图按分类变量的聚合值连线；饼图带右侧图例（含百分比）
- 好处：任意缩放不糊、配色统一、可被 `pspp_chart` 工具直接返回结构化数据
- 仍然走 PSPP 的情形：用户在语法视图里手写 `GRAPH …` 或 `FREQUENCIES /BARCHART`，那类图仍是 PSPP 的 PNG（样式固定、不能改）

## 数据模型

- 打开 `.sav` / `.por` 时复制一份到 `~/.dsh/analytics/<sessionId>/work.sav` 作为工作副本，原始文件不动
- `.csv` / `.txt` / `.tsv` 自动推断类型后导入
- 变量字典来自 `DISPLAY DICTIONARY`（名称、标签、测度、格式、缺失值、值标签）
- 数据页通过 `SAVE TRANSLATE /TYPE=CSV` 读出并分页提供给网格；默认上限 20 万行（`config.maxRows`）
- 写回：内存模型 → CSV → `GET DATA /TYPE=TXT` + `VARIABLE LABELS`/`VALUE LABELS`/`MISSING VALUES`/`VARIABLE LEVEL` → `SAVE OUTFILE`

## 数据编辑与联动

- 数据视图：双击单元格改值；**键盘导航** ↑↓←→ 移动、Tab 横向移动、Enter/F2 进入编辑、Delete 清空、Esc 取消；「数据」菜单支持插入变量（对话框可设类型/宽度/小数/标签/值标签/缺失值/测量级别）、插入个案、删除个案、排序个案（升序/降序）、转置（走 PSPP `FLIP`）
- 变量视图：类型/宽度/小数/标签/测量/对齐就地编辑，× 删除变量；「值」列点开值标签编辑器（每行 `值=标签`），保存后数据视图立刻显示标签；「缺失」列可直接输入（空格分隔，数值/字符串均支持），写入 `MISSING VALUES`
- 合并文件（「数据 → 合并文件」/`pspp_merge`）：添加个案走 `ADD FILES`，按关键变量合并走 `MATCH FILES /BY`，结果写回工作文件
- 数据变更在原文件之外进行：存到 `work.sav`，只有点「保存」才会写回你打开的路径
- 输出菜单：每张表格右上角「复制 CSV / 下载 CSV」；「文件 → 导出表格为 CSV…」把所有表格拼成一个文件；「导出输出为 HTML…」连表格与图表打包成一个本地文件；「导出输出为 PDF…/ODT…」把最近一次运行重放成可打印文档（`pspp_export_document`）
- **对话联动**：面板和对话里的 agent 共用同一个会话工作区；agent 用 `pspp_*` 工具改了数据或产出新表格后，面板在 3 秒内刷新并提示「PSPP 有新输出」

## 分析对话框

每个分析/转换对话框都是 SPSS 式的两栏布局：左侧是变量列表，右侧是一组目标框（因变量、自变量、分组变量……）。点右栏某框让它成为活动框，再点左侧变量把它移入/移出该框；选中项在框里显示成可点的 chip。

标题行下方的「统计量… / 选项… / 图表… / 单元格… / 事后检验…」按钮打开嵌套的选项面板，勾选项直接映射到 PSPP 子命令：

| 过程 | 选项组 → 语法 |
| --- | --- |
| 频率 | 统计量 → `/STATISTICS=MEAN STDDEV …`；百分位 → `/PERCENTILES=`；图表 → `/BARCHART` `/HISTOGRAM` |
| 描述 | 统计量 → `/STATISTICS=MEAN STDDEV MIN MAX SEMEAN VARIANCE RANGE SKEWNESS KURTOSIS SUM` |
| 交叉表 | 统计量 → `/STATISTICS=CHISQ PHI CC LAMBDA GAMMA`；单元格 → `/CELLS=COUNT ROW COLUMN EXPECTED` |
| 探索 | 绘图 → `/PLOT=BOXPLOT HISTOGRAM NPPLOT` |
| 平均值 | 单元格统计 → `/CELLS=` |
| 独立样本 T | 选项 → `/CRITERIA=CI(.95)` |
| 单样本 T | 检验值 → `/TESTVAL=`；选项 → `/CRITERIA=CI(.95)` |
| 单因素 ANOVA | 统计量 → `/STATISTICS=DESCRIPTIVES HOMOGENEITY`；事后 → `/POSTHOC=TUKEY LSD BONFERRONI` |
| 相关 | 选项 → `/PRINT=TWOTAIL\|ONETAIL NOSIG`、`/MISSING=PAIRWISE\|LISTWISE` |
| 回归 | 统计量 → `/STATISTICS=R COEFF ANOVA CI` |
| 因子 | 输出 → `/PRINT=INITIAL EXTRACTION KMO`；旋转用字段下拉 |
| 非参数检验（8 个） | 卡方 `/CHISQUARE=VAR /EXPECTED=EQUAL`、二项式 `/BINOMIAL(.5)`、K-S 正态性 `/K-S(NORMAL)`、游程 `/RUNS(MEDIAN)`、Wilcoxon `/WILCOXON`、符号 `/SIGN`、Mann-Whitney `/MANN-WHITNEY … BY`、Kruskal-Wallis `/KRUSKAL-WALLIS … BY`、Friedman `/FRIEDMAN` |

细节约定：

- 变量列表按当前活动框的类型过滤：需要数值的框（检验变量/因变量）会把字符串变量置灰，需要分组的框接受任意类型
- 「组值」框会从该分组变量的值标签或已加载的个案里生成可勾选项（最多选两个），没有可选值时退回手填
- 图形菜单的条形图/直方图/散点图与统计对话框共用同一套两栏布局
- 输出区的宽表自动横向滚动、字号压到 11px；图表点击可放大，标题栏「关闭」退出

PSPP 2.1.3 的语法差异：`REGRESSION /STATISTICS=TOL`（含 `ALL`）会报「没有找到有效数据」并 rc=1，所以回归只发 `R COEFF ANOVA CI`；`RELIABILITY /STATISTICS` 尚未实现，可靠性对话框只发 `/SCALE('all') ALL /MODEL=ALPHA`。

## Agent 工具

26 个，**由插件自带的「统计分析」Agent 预设挂载**（`preset-analytics` → `dsh-analytics/tools`）：新建会话时选「统计分析」，这些工具才出现在那个会话里；用别的预设的会话看不到它们，省下的正是这 26 条工具定义每次请求都要占的上下文。宿主半在 `index.js` 里把工作区注册成 `analytics` 服务，预设半据此拿同一个数据集，所以面板和对话永远改的是同一份数据。想让老装法（每个会话都带工具）继续工作，把 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `analytics` 行的 `registerTools` 改成 `true`。

33 个：`pspp_status` `pspp_open` `pspp_new` `pspp_add_variable` `pspp_append_cases` `pspp_variables` `pspp_data` `pspp_run` `pspp_run_file` `pspp_convert` `pspp_analyze` `pspp_transform` `pspp_chart` `pspp_publication_table` `pspp_pairwise` `pspp_partial` `pspp_cox` `pspp_discriminant` `pspp_cluster` `pspp_timeseries` `pspp_multinomial` `pspp_ordinal` `pspp_poisson` `pspp_wls` `pspp_twostage` `pspp_distribution` `pspp_edit_chart` `pspp_save` `pspp_merge` `pspp_export_document` `pspp_export_office` `pspp_export_chart` `pspp_export`

- `pspp_analyze`：frequencies / descriptives / crosstabs / ttest_independent / ttest_paired / ttest_one_sample / oneway / glm / correlation / regression / logistic / factor / reliability / npar（卡方）/ npar_binomial / npar_ks / npar_runs / npar_wilcoxon / npar_sign / npar_mannwhitney / npar_kruskal / npar_friedman / examine / means / ctables / roc / cluster（npar 子过程与「分析 → 非参数检验」对话框生成同一份语法）
- `pspp_transform`：compute / recode / sort / aggregate / select / filter / weight / split / rename / delete / sample / count / rank（全部写回数据集）
- `pspp_run`：任意 PSPP 语法，返回表格矩阵、图表文件路径与诊断

## 配置（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆写 `analytics` 行）

```yaml
- id: analytics
  config:
    engineDir: /path/to/pspp-engine   # 可选，覆盖包内 engine/（也可直接指向某个平台目录）
    dataDir: /path/to/dsh-home        # 可选，默认 ~/.dsh
    maxRows: 200000
    timeoutMs: 120000
    safer: false
    evictIdle: true      # 关掉后会话数据集常驻内存
    maxIdleMs: 1800000   # 空闲多久释放（毫秒）
    registerTools: false # true = 回到 0.26 之前的做法：每个会话都挂 27 个 pspp_* 工具
```

`registerTools: false`（默认）时工具只由预设半 `dsh-analytics/tools` 提供，也就是只出现在选了「统计分析」预设的会话里。它会被记进启动日志：`[dsh-analytics] <版本> routes ready (registerTools=false)`。

## 性能与规模（实测，2026-11-14，测试机：Fedora 44 x86-64 / 32 GB 内存）

| 场景 | 时间 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 导入 1 万例 × 7 变量 CSV | 473 ms | 含类型推断与写回 .sav |
| 导入 5 万例 CSV | 1400 ms | — |
| 1 万例 FREQUENCIES / CROSSTABS+CHISQ / DESCRIPTIVES / 回归 | 237 / 146 / 143 / 142 ms | 单次引擎调用 |
| 5 万例另存 .sav | 1108 ms | 2.6 MB |
| 5 万例 .sav 重新打开 | 709 ms | 个案数与数值逐位一致 |
| 27 张表 + 2 张图导出 .docx | 573 ms | 10.9 MB（含一张 4135 行的频率表） |
| 同上导出 .xlsx（含隐藏数据页） | 591 ms | 8.5 MB，29 张工作表，LibreOffice 无 `Err:`/`#NAME` |
| 3 个会话并发各跑一次回归 | — | 各自独立运行目录，互不干扰 |

- `maxRows` 默认 200000：超过就截断并在状态里标 `truncated`。
- `timeoutMs` 默认 120000：单个引擎进程的上限，超时按失败处理。
- 矩阵超过 500 行的表会自动附注（多半是把连续变量放进了频率表），导出 Word 会因此很大；这类表请改用描述统计。
- 会话内存：`WorkspaceRegistry` 每 30 分钟释放一次没被访问、也不在屏幕上的会话数据集（磁盘文件不动，下次请求自动重开）；`config.evictIdle: false` 可关掉。

## 与 SPSS 的对应

`docs/FEATURES.md` 第 14 节按 SPSS 的菜单路径列了对照表（哪一项在这里点哪里、是原生支持、换个名字、插件自算，还是引擎支持但面板没开放）。第 13 节把「已知限制」逐条对着引擎实测过一遍，每条都附引擎原文，方便用同样的命令复核：PSPP 2.1.3 自己没实现的是生存分析、判别分析、混合/多变量模型、决策树、数据重构（`CASESTOVARS`/`VARSTOCASES`）、时间序列、多重插补、复杂抽样、曲线估计、对数线性、多维标度；偏相关与多选题由插件自己算。转置（`FLIP`）只保留数值列，字符串列的内容会被丢掉，所以面板会先拦一次。

## 已知取舍

- 「选择个案」用 `SELECT IF` + 保存实现，不满足条件的个案会被真正删除（SPSS 是临时过滤）；对话框里已标注
- 转置沿用 PSPP `FLIP`：字符串列会变成 0/1 编码列，变量名变为 `VAR000…`
- 撤销按「一次编辑一步」记录，内存预算默认 4 000 000 个单元格（`historyBudgetCells`），超出后丢最早的那几步并在状态栏提示；查找/替换支持限定变量，输出窗口另有独立的搜索框（Ctrl+F）
- 曲线估计（`CURVEFIT`）在 PSPP 2.1.3 里只解析不执行（`CURVEFIT尚未实现`），因此没有对应对话框；曲线拟合请用 `COMPUTE` + `REGRESSION` 或 `pspp_run` 写公式
- 界面语言覆盖「菜单/对话框/提示/通知/面板表注前缀/Word-Excel 导出外壳」（`locale/en.json`，1292 条，含 `{0}` 模板）；**表注正文**（按数据算出来的说明，例如「期望频数不足」「方差不等」）与**长段错误解释**仍由宿主拼中文——它们含具体数字与变量名，整句翻译会失真，所以英文界面下这些正文保持中文，前缀与外壳跟语言走。
- 翻译规则是「整串命中 → `{0}` 模板 → 原样返回」，**没有**「把词典里的短词挨个塞进句子」这条兜底：那条规则会把长句切碎成 `Homogeneity of variance test的 p < 0.001` 这种半汉半英。查不到就整句保持中文，读起来至少是通顺的
- 面板的 HTTP 接口（`/analytics/api/*`）跟着宿主一起走 DSH 自己的鉴权；其中 `api/version` 在插件层不查 cookie，但宿主更外层的 `/api` 围栏仍然挡（实测不带 cookie 仍是 `401 unauthorized`），带 cookie 时只回 `{ok, plugin, version}`。其余接口：浏览器必须持有宿主启动时打印那条带 `?token=` 的地址换来的 cookie（`dsh-auth-<hash>`，30 天）。直接手敲 `http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/analytics/api/state` 会得到 `401 unauthorized` —— 这是宿主行为，不是插件在要求登录；错过那条 URL 时重开一次 `dsh web` 会打印新的地址

## 开发

```bash
npm test                     # build（纯函数）+ engine（平台解析）+ client（jsdom 挂 bundle）+ smoke + routes
npm run doctor               # dsh-plugin-toolkit 的九项清单检查（engines.dsh / files 覆盖 / 根导出等）
npm run verify:pack          # 打 tarball → 装进临时目录 → 确认装完的副本里有面板代码（跳过 mount；需 npm ≤ 11，见下）
npm run engine:fetch         # 拉本机平台的预编译引擎（engine-v* Release）
node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs   # 本机从源码重建自带引擎
npm pack                     # 打 tgz（含 engine/）
```

### 用 dsh-plugin-toolkit 检查

`npm run doctor` 与 `npm run verify:pack` 跑的是 [`dsh-plugin-toolkit`](https://github.com/WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit) 的检查：九项清单（`version` 语义化、`engines.dsh`、README 的 Requirements 段、`dsh.bundle.patch` 与其文件、`dsh.client` 与 client 入口、`files` 是否覆盖 exports/patch/client、根导出是不是带 `apply` 的插件）以及"打包后真装一遍"。CI 里两者都跑，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。

⚠️ `verify` 读 `npm pack --json` 的输出：npm 12 返回的是按包名索引的对象，工具按早期版本的数组解析，会报 `object is not iterable`。本地 npm 12 想跑它，得在 PATH 前面挂一份 npm 11（`npm i --prefix /tmp/npm11 npm@11` 后用 `PATH=/tmp/npm11/node_modules/.bin:$PATH` 执行）；CI 的 node 20/22 自带 npm 10/11，不受影响。

它的 `verify` 默认还会把面板挂到 jsdom 里，但这一步对**本插件不成立**：我们的界面是 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的页签，而工具内置的 stub host 没有 `betterSidebar` 服务，挂载必然报 "registered nothing"。所以 CI 用 `--no-mount`，客户端那一半改由 `test/client.mjs` 覆盖——它自带一个提供 `betterSidebar` 与 `sidebarRight` 的 host，把 `registerTab` / `registerFileViewer` 的登记、菜单栏渲染、空工作台不显示标签条、以及"文件面板转交后关掉自己的中转标签"都断言了一遍。

### 改了代码之后怎么生效

| 改的是 | 生效方式 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js`（面板界面） | 刷新页面即可；`npx dsh-plugin-toolkit dev .` 会在拷过去之后自动重载 |
| `lib/*.js`、`index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` 的配置（后端一半：工具、路由、引擎调用） | `plugin_manager` 的 disable → enable 即可，**不用重启**：宿主自带的 `dsh-hmr` 在重载时会比对已加载模块的 `ino:size:mtime`，改过的模块被剔出 ESM 缓存后重新求值。Linux 与 Windows 两端实测都成立（2026-11-14 Windows 用 `pspp_status` 的 `plugin.version` 复核过）。前提是**改完再等一下再重载**——插件目录若走 SMB 链接（如 `link:Z:\work\dsh-analytics`），Windows 重定向器会缓存远程文件元数据约 10 秒，太快重载会读到旧 mtime、判定「没变」 |

面板的 `client.js` 由宿主从磁盘读取，改完**刷新页面**就是新的；后端的版本号读的是每次现读的 `package.json`（0.23.8 起不再用模块缓存的 JSON），所以 `plugin.version` 变化等于后端模块真的换过。

判断跑的是哪一版：面板状态栏右下角显示 `v0.23.14` 这样的版本号，`pspp_status` 的返回里也有 `plugin.version`；两者都对得上才说明新代码真的在跑。宿主日志里每次装载会打一行 `[dsh-analytics] <版本> routes ready`。

还想在跑着的应用里看改动时，用它的 `dev`：

```bash
npx dsh-plugin-toolkit@latest dev . --host http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

它把 `client.js` 拷到运行中的 profile 并靠 `/plugins/events` 的 `rebuilt` 帧确认真的重载了（改完刷新页面即可，不用重启 dsh）。

### CI 的一个坑

`test.yml` 带 `paths-ignore`，而 GitHub 对**没有父提交的 push**（重写历史后第一次推）算不出 diff，于是这条工作流不会自动跑。改完历史的那一版要么手动触发（`gh workflow run test.yml --ref master`），要么随便推一个有实际改动的提交。`build-engine.yml` 不吃路径过滤，所以 `engine-v*` 标签被移动时会真的重跑一次引擎构建。

安装、依赖矩阵、打 tgz（自带引擎版 / 通用版）、卸载与引擎重建见 [docs/install.md](docs/install.md)。

## 许可

- 本插件代码：MIT（`LICENSE`）
- 内置引擎：GNU PSPP，GPLv3+（`engine/<平台>/COPYING`、`NOTICE`），源码对应 GNU PSPP 2.1.3 发布包
